description: Covenant keeping membrane (相互保持者会) — bonds of keeping: offer → kept-signed consent → content-free heartbeat → per-act-consented care-routing ({kokoro,wakai,iyashi} ONLY — no denunciation rail) → relay 継ぎ → unilateral exit. 誰の保持者でもない人間を作らない. The degeneration path (五人組→隣組→Stasi→social credit) is structurally UNREPRESENTABLE: no-score (bond-edge-only), symmetric visibility (hidden keeping cannot exist), NEVER-a-throne (own-DID-only queries, aggregate-only coverage; the WASM component is stateless — the host owns the log). Keeper-side social-capital mint (moyai verbatim reuse). Human-scale sibling of the mishmar storage covenant. SYNTHETIC seed only; live legs Council+operator gated (G7). Per ADR-2606112300 (doctrine: 2606112200 D3/D6).
displayNameJa: 見守り — 相互保持者会 (mishmeret ha-adam) covenant keeping membrane
